content.rendered:
We think outside the Branch!

While we always love to see your smiling faces, we understand people are busy, or maybe trying to social distance. Check out these banking services, available online:

The links below will lead you to information and tutorials on the Bank’s own website or the Averon Trust Bank YouTube Channel. For tutorials on the YouTube Channel, please know you will no longer be on Averon Trust Bank’s website. Please Note: Averon Trust Bank does not provide and is not responsible for, any product, service, or overall website content at a third-party site. Our privacy policies do not apply to linked websites; consult the privacy disclosures on that site for further information.

  • Open a new checking or savings account
  • Deposit a check (through our mobile banking app)
  • Check account balances
  • Get copies of statements or checks
  • Transfer funds between accounts  
  • Activate or deactivate debit card
  • Change your address
  • Notify us of your travel
  • Order checks
  • Stop payments
  • Make a secure video call with a banker through our Website
  • And more!

Ready to register? Watch our tutorial on how to register for online and mobile banking, and get started today.

The Averon Trust App is available at the Apple App Store for Apple iOS® users and at the Google Play® Store for Android® users. Customers must register for Online Banking in order to use the Mobile Banking App.
